text:
Lindqvist Dairy is recalling its 500g oat yoghurt cups after internal testing found a risk of fermentation swelling in sealed packs. The company said 18,400 units were shipped nationwide between 4 and 19 October from its Brackenridge plant. No illnesses have been reported, but retailers have been told to pull all lots with the codes OY-104 through OY-119.

Chief operations officer Maja Lindqvist said the defect was traced to a faulty temperature control valve on one filling line. Customers are being offered refunds or replacements.

For the sector, the recall is another reminder that oat-based dairy alternatives are still scaling up production quality controls, with shelf-life consistency now a bigger competitive issue than demand.
